description: S. De S. Wettasinghe v. M.C. Thenuwara S. De S. Wettasinghe v. M.C. Thenuwara View More before Hon. Eric Basnayake, J.
parties: S. De S. Wettasinghe v. M.C. Thenuwara S. De S. Wettasinghe v. M.C. Thenuwara View More
keywords: Respondent-Petitioner sought to set aside several District Court orders, including a decree absolute entered against him for non-appearance. Held - Court upheld the preliminary objection that where an alternative remedy exists under Section 389 of the Civil Procedure Code, revisionary jurisdiction cannot be invoked; Respondent-Petitioner failed to adduce any evidence at the inquiry to establish non-service of the decree nisi; Application dismissed with cost for failure to show exceptional circumstances.
legistation: Sections 389 and 839 of the Civil Procedure Code
